flora: Mature Ginkgo tree (tall, distinctive fan-shaped leaves, elegant branching structure, light-colored bark)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; tactile, high-quality textures; emphasis on the distinctive shape and texture of the ginkgo; no sharp aggressive angles; overall ancient and verdant feel.

visual_logic.composition: A slightly low-angle, distant view of a single, prominent mature Ginkgo tree, standing elegantly in a semi-arid landscape. Its distinctive fan-shaped leaves should be clearly visible, and its form should dominate the frame. Some sparse undergrowth around its base.
visual_logic.ground: Pale, dusty tan earth with scattered chalky nodules, providing a natural, open backdrop.
visual_logic.lighting: High-key direct sunlight creating a warm glow, highlighting the texture of the bark and the color of the leaves.
